observations: Photo 0: front view of a silver/grey pickup truck, Toyota grille badge visible, parked on gravel at what looks like a car lot with umbrella shades and other vehicles in background.
Photo 1: front-three-quarter view, same truck, black alloy-style wheels, roof rails visible, no visible moonroof glass from this angle.
Photo 2: rear view of the same truck. The rear window has hand-written marker text reading approximately 'No Start 963' - this looks like an auction/lot tag, not a seller's own marking.
Tailgate badge in photo 2 appears to read 'TACOME' rather than 'TACOMA' - either a worn/damaged badge or a sign of a non-genuine or mismatched part.
A 'V6' badge is visible on the right side of the tailgate in photo 2, consistent with a V6 trim tailgate.
No VIN plate, dashboard, instrument cluster, engine bay, interior, or start-up shown in any photo.
No customs/duty paperwork, plate number, or registration document shown.
Styling (grille, headlights, tailgate) resembles the pre-2024 (third generation, roughly 2016-2023) Tacoma body, not the redesigned fourth-generation 2024 Tacoma.

claims.evidence: Photos 0-2 show third-generation Tacoma body styling (pre-redesign), not the 2024 fourth-generation Tacoma's distinct front and tailgate design.
No import sticker, VIN, or paperwork visible in any photo.
No TRD badge or 4x4 drivetrain marking clearly visible on grille, fender, or tailgate in any photo.
A 'V6' tailgate badge is visible in photo 2, but badge alone does not confirm the actual engine installed.
No interior/dashboard photo showing a start button.
No roof-glass or interior headliner shot in any of the 3 photos.
No customs/duty certificate or document shown.

risks.risk: The rear window carries a hand-written 'No Start' tag, strongly suggesting the vehicle was tagged non-running at an auction/lot and this was not disclosed by the seller.
risks.proof: A video clip of the seller starting the engine and it running, plus a clear photo without the tag obscured.

risks.risk: Tailgate badge appears misspelled ('TACOME'), raising doubt about whether this is a genuine Toyota tailgate/trim or a reworked/rebadged unit, possibly linked to accident or parts-swap history.
risks.proof: Close-up, well-lit photo of the tailgate badge and a VIN plate photo to cross-check against Toyota records.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverifiable trim/possible accident history, discounted accordingly

risks.risk: Claimed model year (2024) does not match the body styling seen, suggesting a possible misrepresented year to inflate price.
risks.proof: VIN plate photo or registration document showing the manufacture year.
risks.if_unproven: priced as the older generation model year, not 2024

risks.risk: No engine bay, interior, or odometer photo, so mechanical condition, mileage, and interior condition (including the moonroof claim) cannot be assessed.
risks.proof: Photos of engine bay, dashboard/odometer, and interior roof.
risks.if_unproven: priced as base condition with no extras confirmed, and engine priced as not working per the 'No Start' tag

risks.risk: No customs duty certificate shown despite the 'verified duty' claim, which matters for import vehicles in Abuja.
risks.proof: Photo of the customs duty certificate/paper with matching chassis number.
risks.if_unproven: priced as duty-unverified, with added import risk

proof_requests: A video of the engine being started and idling, showing the key/push-button and the dashboard.
A clear, unobstructed photo of the VIN plate and chassis number.
A photo of the customs duty certificate matching the VIN.
Interior photos: dashboard, odometer, seats, and roof (to confirm moonroof).
A close-up of the tailgate 'TACOME/TACOMA' badge and TRD badge if present.
response.reason: The seller presents this as a pristine, fully-featured 2024 foreign-used TRD Tacoma, but photo 2 shows an undisclosed auction-style 'No Start' tag on the rear window and a misspelled tailgate badge, both of which suggest the vehicle's true condition and authenticity are being concealed rather than merely unverified.
